pitch: Staff any project with coordinated subagent roles. This is the real CLI, running in your browser, installing into an empty Claude Code setup.
welcome: [1mStaffed[0m installs product-team roles (PM, UX, architect, builder, reviewer...) as subagents for Pi, Codex or Claude Code.
This sandbox has an empty ~/.claude folder, so it installs for Claude Code.
staffed enable --profile anthropic    install all eleven roles and the discovery skill
staffed status                        what is installed, and which model each tier uses
staffed compose pm decisive sceptic   check a role with modifiers, and what it means
cat .claude/agents/pm.md              read a persona your agent will dispatch
